title: prunella vulgaris var. intermedia
intro: Prunella vulgaris var. intermedia, commonly known as self-heal, is a perennial herb belonging to the mint family (Lamiaceae). It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which can help to boost the immune system, reduce stress, and alleviate symptoms of anxiety and insomnia. The therapeutic actions of Prunella vulgaris var. intermedia include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory and antiseptic agent, which can help to speed up the healing process of wounds and reduce the risk of infection. The bioactive constituents of Prunella vulgaris var. intermedia include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been shown to exhibit anti-cancer and anti-viral activities.
